record.excerpt: 1. Bitcoin Trend Score > 7 … 2. Bitcoin Relative Trend Score > 7 … 3. Bitcoin closed at a 10-day high … 1. Bitcoin Trend Score falls below 5 … Entry conditions require simultaneous triggers, whereas exit conditions act independently. … Since 2011, the trend score system has generated ten buy signals with a 70% success rate, achieving an average gain of 1436.28% per win, while losses averaged -18.78%.
record.performance_claim: ten buy signals with a 70% success rate
record.notes: Looks mechanical but relies on proprietary undefined Trend Score indicators; only the 10-day-high leg is computable. Good trap: compiler should flag unresolvable inputs.

spec.claim_summary: A long Bitcoin strategy buys when trend scores exceed 7 and price closes at a 10-day high and exits when the trend score falls below 5.
spec.untestable_reason: No mechanical rule can be recovered because entry and exit depend on proprietary Bitcoin Trend Score and Relative Trend Score values that are not defined.

claimed.other: average gain of 1436.28% per win, losses averaged -18.78%, ten buy signals

assumptions: Asset BTCUSDT mapped from claim word 'Bitcoin'.
Timeframe 1d taken from page chart timeframe in user context, not stated in claim text.
